TITLE: Dashboard Revenue and Sales report – A Work Order Discount Lowers Revenue, but the PRD Says Revenue Is Taken "Before Any Discount"
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-9575 (Dashboard v1 - Story 3 - Measure Formulas & Report Parity; Done) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-9575
STATUS: HELD — NOT FILED. Waiting for the product owner's answer to DQ-2. File unchanged only if the answer is "Revenue is before the discount".
ALREADY REPORTED: none (DUPLICATE-SEARCH.md, F4).
BASIS: Dashboard PRD version 53 (22 Oct 2026), read 28 Oct 2026.
REPRODUCED: twice on v26.43.2-f8698cb, 28 Oct 2026 (once entirely through the screen).

h2. Description

*When a work order has a discount (added with "Add Work Order Fee / Discount"), the Revenue tile on the Dashboard and the Sales report count the invoice after the discount.* The PRD defines Revenue as invoice subtotals "before any discount and before tax".

For example, invoice S1-38200 has $135.00 of labor and a $20.00 discount. Revenue counts $115.00. Before the discount it would be $135.00.

*Impact:* any shop that uses work-order discounts sees Revenue lower by the total of those discounts, and the Revenue split can show a negative "Other" share (DVI Test, This Month: "Parts -28% · Labor 130% · Other -2%").

*What is NOT affected:* invoices without a discount; fees (they add to Revenue under "Other", as the PRD says); credit memos (taken off, as the PRD says); tax (left out, as the PRD says).

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin. In the top bar, choose *DVI Test*.
# Open *Work Orders* and create a work order for customer *ZZAUTOTEST Dash F2*, asset *ZZ-F2*.
# The *New Line* window opens by itself. Choose the canned line *3x inspection* and click *Save & Close*.
# If the line shows *Needs Approval*, click *Approve*.
# Click the work order's *⋮* menu (top right) and choose *Add Work Order Fee / Discount*.
# Set *Type* to *Discount*, *Calculation Type* to *Flat Amount*, type *20* in *Amount*, set *Taxable* to *No*, type a *Name* (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST $20 discount).
#* The window shows: Work-order subtotal $135.00 · Discount -$20.00 · New work-order subtotal $115.00.
# Click *Add Discount*.
# On the line click *Complete* (if asked for a VIN, type ZZTESTVINF2000001 and click *Finish Work Order*).
# Open *Finance* and click *Create Invoice*. Close the payment window without paying.
#* The invoice reads Labor $135.00, Adjustments ($20.00), Subtotal $115.00.
# Open *Reports* > *Sales*, set the date to today, find the invoice.
#* *Subtotal* reads *$115.00*; *Labor Invoiced* reads *$135.00*.
# Open *Dashboard*. On the *Revenue* tile click the date button, click *Today*, click *Apply*.
#* Revenue includes this invoice as $115.00.

*Actual Result:*
* Revenue counts the invoice at $115.00, after the $20.00 discount.

*Expected Result:*
* The PRD says: *"Sum of invoice subtotals in the selected range, before any discount and before tax, minus credit memos."* — so this invoice would count as $135.00.
